items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Alfred Ljon and Frank Wolff. They were both also in that Village scene... Frank bought the band a drink... Frank cut us off from the bar

ctx.x: How did you get in with --

Alfred Lion? Well, Alfred Lion again was part of the aficionado scene. Alfred Ljon and Frank Wolff. They were both also in that Village scene, as was in part the Turkish ambassador's Ertegun sons, You could see their faces now and then.
